name: 1MSE-KUP24
description: 1MSE-KUP24 was a KUP24 messenger droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spices mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 10 BBY, 1MSE-KUP24 was present in the mines' control room when it was taken over by a group of criminals who started a revolution against the Pykes. Joyful at his liberation, 1MSE-KUP24 joined the revolt.
